name: Avocado

pros.title: sweet role is easy to understand
pros.explanation: It can be useful when sweetness is the job and the portion is deliberate.

pros.title: easy to use as a whole food
pros.explanation: Simple, recognisable, and realistic for everyday eating.

pros.title: brings a clean fruit identity
pros.explanation: It still contributes something valuable even when it is not elite.

cons.title: portions are easy to overshoot
cons.explanation: Dense or snackable formats punish casual serving sizes.

cons.title: can be easy to waste if timing is off
cons.explanation: Perishability is a practical downside people actually feel.

cons.title: ripeness window is annoyingly narrow
cons.explanation: It can go from not ready to overripe fast.
